app.name: Campfire Tales
app.tagline: Run your 2024-rules fantasy campaign on your own host.

connection.label: Connection
connection.disconnected: Disconnected. Actions are paused until the connection returns.

save.failed: Language preference could not be saved. It still applies on this device.

auth.signInIntro: Use the account your Dungeon Master created or the one you made with an invite.
auth.registerIntro: Enter the invite code from your Dungeon Master to join their campaign.
auth.bootstrapIntro: No accounts exist yet. Create the first account; it will run campaigns as Dungeon Master.
auth.usernameHint: 3–32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
auth.pitchTitle: Your table. Your rules. Your server.
auth.pitch1: Runs on the Dungeon Master’s computer. Players only open a link.
auth.pitch2: Players join with a one-time invite code.
auth.pitch3: Everyone picks English or Bahasa Indonesia for themselves.

lobby.title: Your campaigns
lobby.empty: You are not in any campaign yet. Create one or join with an invite.
lobby.subtitle: Pick up where your party left off, or gather a new one.

room.removeBody: They lose access right away. You can invite them again later.
room.invitesIntro: Each code lets one player join. Codes are shown once, when created.
room.newInviteHelp: Copy it now and send it to your player. It will not be shown again.
room.noAccess: You do not have access to this campaign.
room.noCharacters: No characters yet. Each player creates their own.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not match any page.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username and password do not match.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.ORIGIN_REJECTED: This request came from an unexpected page and was blocked.
errors.BOOTSTRAP_CLOSED: This host is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code is not valid or was already used.
errors.CANNOT_REMOVE_DM: The Dungeon Master cannot be removed.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That member is no longer in the campaign.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{retryAfterSeconds}} seconds.
errors.UNKNOWN_COMMAND: The host does not recognise that action.
errors.REQUEST_ID_REUSED: That action conflicts with an earlier one. Refresh and try again.
errors.STALE_REVISION: Someone changed this first. Review the latest version and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That item could not be found.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: That file type is not supported.
errors.OFFLINE: You are offline. Nothing was sent; try again once reconnected.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on the host. Try again.
errors.CHARACTER_INCOMPLETE: The character still has {{count}} required choice(s) to finish.
errors.CHARACTER_FINAL: This character is finished; it can no longer be edited in the wizard.
errors.ALREADY_ROLLED: Ability scores were already rolled for this character.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The DM does not allow that ability score method.
errors.CHARACTER_NOT_FINAL: Finish the character before using its features.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_OWNED: This character does not have that feature at its current level.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_TRACKED: That feature has no tracked uses; resolve it at the table.
errors.NO_USES_LEFT: No uses left. Check the rules text for when it recovers.
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED: That amount is not allowed for this feature.
errors.ALREADY_INSPIRED: This character already has Heroic Inspiration.
errors.MASTERY_INVALID: Those weapon mastery choices are not allowed ({{issue}}).
errors.MASTERY_CHANGE_NEEDS_REST: Changing a chosen weapon mastery needs a Long Rest (or the DM).
errors.ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: That item is no longer in the inventory.
errors.ATTUNEMENT_LIMIT: A character can be attuned to at most three magic items (four for a level 13 Thief).
errors.ATTUNEMENT_NOT_REQUIRED: That item does not need attunement.
errors.ATTUNEMENT_CLASS: Only certain classes can attune to that item.
errors.SPELLS_INVALID: That spell choice is not allowed ({{issue}}).
errors.NO_SLOT_LEFT: No spell slot of that level is left.
errors.NOT_CONCENTRATION: That spell does not need Concentration.
errors.REST_NEEDS_HP: A character needs at least 1 Hit Point to start a rest.
errors.REST_NEEDS_DM: The DM decides when rests happen in this campaign.
errors.NO_HIT_DICE: No Hit Point Dice left to spend.
errors.HP_INVALID: Hit Points must be between 0 and the maximum ({{max}}).
errors.LEVEL_UP_NOT_AVAILABLE: No level up is available yet (XP or a milestone from the DM is needed).
errors.ADVANCEMENT_INVALID: That level-up choice is not allowed ({{issue}}).
errors.REVISION_REQUIRED: Load the latest state before saving this change.
errors.NOTE_LINK_INVALID: A linked note no longer exists.
errors.HOMEBREW_INVALID: That homebrew entry does not match the rules data format ({{issue}}).
errors.HOMEBREW_FORMULA: Only dice, numbers and ability/proficiency/level names are allowed in formulas ({{path}}).
errors.MONSTER_UNAVAILABLE: That monster is not available in this campaign (unknown or not approved homebrew).
errors.ASSET_INVALID: That file is not a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.ASSET_TOO_LARGE: That image is too large (at most 20 MiB and 40 megapixels).
errors.ASSET_NOT_SHAREABLE: A scene background must be an image shared with the party.
errors.TOKEN_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: That position is outside the map ({{columns}} × {{rows}} squares).
errors.PATH_INVALID: That path is not a chain of neighbouring squares from the token.
errors.MOVE_OVER_BUDGET: That move costs {{costFeet}} feet, exceeding the {{speed}} feet available.
errors.COMBAT_EXISTS: This campaign already has an open combat, or this combat ID has been used.
errors.COMBAT_ENDED: This combat has ended. Prepare a new encounter to fight again.
errors.COMBAT_NOT_ACTIVE: Combat must be in the correct phase for this action.
errors.COMBAT_NOT_YOUR_TURN: Only the active creature can do that. Reactions are available outside your turn.
errors.COMBAT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: That turn resource has already been spent.
errors.COMBATANT_EXISTS: That character is already in this combat.
errors.COMBAT_LIMIT: A combat can contain at most 200 creatures.
errors.TOKEN_LINK_INVALID: Choose an unlinked token for this creature on the combat's battle map.
errors.HP_LINKED: These Hit Points are linked to a character sheet or combat. Edit them on the sheet or combat tracker.
errors.DICE_INVALID: Use sums or subtractions of dice and integers: at most 100 dice, 1000 sides, and 100 characters.
errors.D20_INVALID: Enter a whole-number modifier from -100 to 100 and a valid target number.
errors.ROLL_EXISTS: That roll ID has already been used.
errors.ROLL_PRIVATE_REQUIRED: This creature is hidden. Choose a private roll.
errors.CONDITION_IMMUNE: This creature is immune to one of those conditions.
errors.DEATH_SAVE_INVALID: A death save is not available now, or was already rolled this turn.
errors.COMBAT_CANNOT_ACT: This creature cannot perform that action or movement in its current state.
errors.ACTION_INVALID: This action cannot be taken now ({{issue}}).
errors.SESSION_EXISTS: A session is already running or paused.
errors.SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE: This session is not in a state that allows that.
errors.RESOLUTION_REACTIONS_PENDING: Reactions are still offered; decide them or commit without waiting.
errors.REACTION_NOT_OFFERED: That reaction is not offered for this resolution.
errors.COMMAND_UNCERTAIN: The host may have saved this command before the response was lost. Retry the same command to recover its result.

reference.title: Rules reference
reference.searchHint: English and Indonesian terms both work.
reference.noResults: No results. Try another word, or the English term.
reference.noBookmarks: Nothing saved yet. Use Bookmark on any entry.
reference.sourceGuide: Written for this app to help beginners; not SRD text.
reference.sourceCampaign: Campaign content, shown only to members allowed to see it.
reference.translatedNote: Unofficial app translation; the English source is kept.
reference.intro: New to tabletop roleplaying? Start here, or search for any word you heard at the table. Reading a rule never spends anything.

save.error: Not saved. Your input is kept here; we will retry when connected.

help.concept: Who is your character? A short idea is enough; you can refine it later.
help.species: Species sets your size, Speed and special traits.
help.background: Your background raises ability scores and gives an Origin feat, skills and a tool.
help.class: Your class decides Hit Points, saving throws, armor training and skill choices.
help.abilities: Pick a method allowed by your DM, then assign a score to each ability.
help.equipment: Choose starting equipment, tools and two languages besides Common.

warning.ARMOR_UNTRAINED: No armor training for {{armor}}: Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity D20 Tests, and no spellcasting.
warning.SHIELD_UNTRAINED: No training with {{armor}}: you gain no AC from it while untrained.
warning.ARMOR_STRENGTH: {{armor}} needs Strength {{strength}}: your Speed drops by 10 feet.
warning.FEAT_CHOICES_PENDING: {{feat}} has choices (such as spells) you will make later.

character.increase21: +2 to one ability and +1 to another
character.backgroundGrants: Also grants skills {{skills}} and the {{feat}} feat.

method.roll: Roll 4d6, drop the lowest (recorded by the host)

dm.title: DM tools
dm.overrideHelp: Corrections replace the rules value on the sheet; leave a field empty to use the rules again.

features.title: Features and resources
features.help: Uses are tracked here; the effect itself is resolved at the table using the rules text.

mastery.title: Weapon Mastery
mastery.help: Choose {{count}} kind(s) of weapon whose mastery property you can use.

resources.addHint: Type an item name from the rules, or any other item.
resources.customHint: Not a rules item; it will be added as a custom item.
resources.restByDm: The DM finishes rests for this campaign.

issue.SPELL_NOT_LEVELED: {{subject}} is a cantrip; choose it under cantrips.
issue.SPELL_NOT_ON_LIST: {{subject}} is not on this class’s spell list.
issue.SPELL_LEVEL: {{subject}} is too high a level for now.
issue.SPELL_DUPLICATE: A spell was chosen twice for {{subject}}.
issue.SPELLBOOK_INVALID: {{subject}} cannot go in the spellbook yet.

levelUp.title: Level up

feat.general: Feat (Ability Score Improvement or another feat you qualify for)
feat.epic-boon: Feat (Epic Boon or another feat you qualify for)

levelUp.notesHint: Write choices settled at the table, such as Expertise, Invocations or Metamagic.

issue.MULTICLASS_PREREQUISITE: Multiclassing into {{subject}} needs 13+ in the primary ability of every class.
issue.SUBCLASS_INVALID: {{subject}} is not a subclass of this class.
issue.SUBCLASS_NOT_ALLOWED: A subclass is chosen only once, at the subclass level.
issue.FEAT_NOT_ALLOWED: This level does not grant a feat.
issue.FEAT_CATEGORY: {{subject}} is not a Fighting Style feat.
issue.FEAT_PREREQUISITE: This character does not meet the prerequisite of {{subject}}.
issue.FEAT_TAKEN: {{subject}} was already taken and is not repeatable.
issue.FEAT_INCREASES: Choose the ability increases that {{subject}} allows.
issue.SKILL_NOT_ALLOWED: This class gives no skill when multiclassing.

notes.pick: Choose a note from the list.
notes.emptyDm: No notes yet. Prepared material stays secret until you share it.
notes.emptyParty: The DM has not shared anything yet.
notes.title: Title
notes.bodyHint: Shared with whoever can see this note. **bold**, *italic*, lists and tables work; HTML is shown as plain text.
notes.conflict: This note was changed in another tab or by another device. Your text is still here; nothing was overwritten.
notes.overwrite: Keep mine and save over it

encounters.title: Encounter builder
encounters.name: Name
encounters.guidance: Difficulty is a guide (2024 XP budget, no multiplier for numbers of foes). You decide what happens at the table.

risk.OUTNUMBERED: The party is heavily outnumbered; action economy favours the foes.
risk.HIGH_CR: A monster has a CR above the party level; it may hit very hard.
risk.TERRAIN: Terrain makes this harder than the XP suggests.

issue.PARTY_EMPTY: Choose at least one character or level.
issue.LEVEL_INVALID: Levels must be whole numbers from 1 to 20.
issue.XP_INVALID: A monster has no valid XP value; fix it before estimating.
issue.QUANTITY_INVALID: Monster counts must be whole numbers of 1 or more.

homebrew.title: Campaign homebrew
homebrew.helpDm: Entries you save are approved for the campaign. Review player proposals before they are used.
homebrew.helpPlayer: Propose spells, items, monsters or character options. The DM approves them before the party uses them.
homebrew.name: Name
homebrew.mechanicsHint: Same format as the rules reference. Formulas accept dice like 2d6+3 and names such as str, prof or level, never code.
homebrew.mechanicsInvalid: This is not valid JSON yet.

scenes.title: Scenes and map
scenes.emptyDm: No scenes yet. Create one with a blank grid or an uploaded map.
scenes.emptyPlayer: The DM has not shared a map yet. Play can go on without one.
scenes.keyboardHint: Tab to a token, then use the arrow keys to move your own token one square. You can also drag it.
scenes.name: Scene name
scenes.uploadHint: Only upload maps that are safe for players to see; keep secret maps as DM-only handouts.

toolHint.select: Pick a token, then tap a square, drag it, or use the arrow keys or the form below.
toolHint.measure: Tap two squares, or pick a token and tap a square. Distance follows this scene’s diagonal rule.
toolHint.ping: Tap a square or use the form to show everyone a short ping. Pings are not saved.
toolHint.area: Place a template so everyone sees which squares an effect covers. The DM decides who is affected.
toolHint.reveal: Fog hides tokens outside revealed areas from players. Only use maps that are safe to show.

scenes.pickToken: Pick one of your tokens to move it.

combat.title: Combat tracker
combat.setupHelp: Set initiative and tie order before beginning. In each creature's adjustment panel, link its map token to share HP and the turn movement budget.
combat.noCombat: No combat has been prepared for this campaign.
combat.noVisibleTurn: No visible creature has the active turn.
combat.empty: No creatures in this combat. Add reinforcements or end combat.

dice.title: Dice tray
dice.manualHelp: Manual rolls use the modifier you enter. Rolls do not spend actions or slots, or apply damage. The DM applies effects separately.

actions.title: Guided action
actions.choose: Choose an action, spell or feature
actions.effectConcentrationReplaces: Starts Concentration and ends the current one
actions.effectPoolDm: Opens attacks for this turn (count decided by the DM)
actions.applyHelp: Hit Point changes are proposals; the DM applies them.

automation.automatic: Automatic: cost, rolls and Hit Point changes
automation.assisted: Assisted: some effects need the DM

costKind.pool: Part of the Attack/Multiattack already taken

issue.OPTION_UNKNOWN: This option is no longer available.
issue.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: That turn resource is already spent.
issue.LEGENDARY_OWN_TURN: Legendary Actions are used after another creature's turn.
issue.LEGENDARY_ONCE_PER_ROUND: Already used until the start of its next turn.
issue.CASTING_TIME_TOO_LONG: The casting time is longer than a turn.
issue.SLOT_TOO_LOW: The slot is below the spell's level.
issue.NO_SLOT_LEFT: No spell slot of that level left.
issue.ONE_SLOT_PER_TURN: Only one spell slot can be spent per turn.
issue.OUT_OF_RANGE: A target is out of range.

prompt.CONDITIONAL_DAMAGE: Extra damage depends on a condition in the text.
prompt.RIDER_EFFECT: The text has more effects than damage.
prompt.DAMAGE_ALTERNATIVE: The text offers alternative damage; the first is shown.
prompt.USE_RESTRICTED: Only in a form or situation from the text.
prompt.ATTACK_MANUAL: Attack bonus comes from the caster; roll it in the dice tray.
prompt.SPELLCASTING: Choose and resolve the spell at the table.
prompt.MULTIATTACK_COUNT_DM: The number of attacks depends on the text.
prompt.SPELL_EFFECT_REVIEW: Rolls come from the spell text; check its other effects.
prompt.FEATURE_TIMING: Use it when the text says.
prompt.LEGENDARY_TIMING: Use it right after another creature's turn.
prompt.UPCAST_MANUAL: The higher slot changes something the DM applies.
prompt.TARGET_COUNT_DM: Check how many targets the text allows.
prompt.RANGE_UNVERIFIED: Range or area is checked at the table.
prompt.LONG_RANGE_DISADVANTAGE: Long range: the attack has Disadvantage.

tutorial.startBody: Start a short original adventure with a hook, a skill check and an easy combat. Everything in it can be edited or skipped.
tutorial.guideHelp: Follow these steps in any order; each link opens the real page.

vitals.replaceTemp: Replace Temporary HP even if lower
vitals.monsterSaves: Use death saves for this monster
vitals.reloadHp: Discard HP draft and load latest
vitals.manualHelp: Conditions are tracked; resolve other feature effects at the table. Monster defenses come from the stat block. Saving an override replaces the entire defense profile; empty selections mean none. Use it for character or temporary defenses.
